title: Co-writing a linear algebra textbook
text: Co-writes a roughly 300-page linear algebra textbook together with a mathematician, producing a full-length book rather than a short guide.

title: Home fusor built in 36 hours
text: Builds a neutron-producing nuclear fusor in a home kitchen within 36 hours, with chat-based help throughout the design and assembly.

title: Automated testing of MCP servers
text: Runs hundreds of open-source tool servers in sandboxed containers, classifies why their setups fail, and drafts GitHub issues for the maintainers of the broken ones.

title: Emacs package ported to Rust
text: Ports the slow vault-scanning part of an Emacs note-taking package to Rust, cutting one run from 90 seconds to about 15 milliseconds with almost no hand-written code.

title: Booking flights from a chat
text: Books flights from a chat window by connecting travel search tools to the assistant through a tool-server connector.

title: Godot scenes with generated assets
text: Creates game scenes in the Godot engine using a text assistant together with a 3D asset generator.

title: Node.js debugger for coding tools
text: Gives a coding assistant access to a Node.js inspector so it sets breakpoints, steps through code, reads console output and evaluates expressions instead of adding log lines.

title: 3D meteor shooter in three days
text: Builds a 3D space meteor-shooting browser game in three days with no prior game development experience, iterating on it through prompts.

title: Pastel 3D platformer in Three.js
text: Builds a pastel 3D platformer in Three.js over two weeks, with monsters, hidden easter eggs and an in-game news feed, playable on desktop and mobile.

title: Home Assistant tool server
text: Connects a Home Assistant installation to a chat assistant through a tool server so smart-home devices can be queried and controlled in conversation.

title: Reverse engineering with Frida
text: Attaches Frida instrumentation to a running desktop chat app through a tool server so the assistant inspects and reverse engineers its own process.

title: 8-bit spelling game for a daughter
text: Builds an 8-bit style spelling game for a daughter's upcoming test, fixing reported bugs and usability issues each morning before work.

title: Developing from an iPhone
text: Develops a web page and API from an iPhone by connecting over SSH to a server running a terminal coding tool, then tunnels both to the phone's browser.

title: Fully automated ML experiments
text: Runs machine-learning experiments end to end from a template where the coding tool writes the training code and the user supplies only a working GPU environment and an idea.

title: Gopher client for Zephyr
text: Builds a client for the Gopher internet protocol on top of the Zephyr embedded operating system, documenting the process in an engineering blog post.

title: Writing a full book in an editor
text: Writes a complete book inside a coding editor extension, drafting the manuscript through prompts rather than typing it by hand.

title: Excalidraw drawings into context
text: Extracts only the relevant fields from huge Excalidraw JSON exports so hand-drawn diagrams fit into a coding session's context without flooding it.

title: Native Mac app for debugging
text: Builds a native SwiftUI Mac app for debugging tool servers, about 20,000 lines of code with fewer than 1,000 written by hand.

title: 3D generalization of Go
text: Creates a three-dimensional generalization of the board game Go that runs in the browser against a computer opponent.

title: Continuous CI-driven coding loop
text: Feeds GitHub Actions errors back to the coding tool after every push, running five cloned working copies in parallel that develop, commit and push continuously.

title: Jira tickets into pull requests
text: Turns Jira tickets into ready pull requests through a pipeline of coding, testing and reviewing steps with no human involvement.

title: JSON change-history CLI in Rust
text: Builds a Rust command-line tool in about three hours that stores a changing JSON file's history as small appended deltas instead of full copies.

title: Interactive theorem proving in Lean
text: Completes interactive theorem-proving steps for a formalization project, with a human guiding the overall structure of the proof.

title: Cryptography paper pages to code
text: Turns a selected page of a cryptography paper PDF into Python code, using two passes over the page.

title: Elevator music while code runs
text: Plays elevator music in the background while a coding tool is busy, with three bundled MP3 tracks to start from.

title: Local semantic code search
text: Builds semantic code search that runs entirely on the user's machine, parsing code with tree-sitter, embedding chunks locally and indexing them with FAISS.

title: Bootable Forth operating system
text: Builds a bootable 64-bit x86 operating system in a single session, with a working Forth interpreter where everything is a Forth word.

title: Diagnosing memory crashes live
text: Diagnoses random out-of-memory crashes on a Linux machine in real time by running system commands and inspecting Python and Node processes down to function calls.

title: Mapping a legacy Yii2 codebase
text: Maps how features connect across hundreds of files in a decade-old Yii2 codebase so a team can estimate and plan modernization of a system nobody understood.

title: Menu bar Pomodoro timer
text: Replaces a paid menu bar Pomodoro app that kept asking for license re-entry with a minimal macOS timer built in about an hour.

title: Meal planning and symptom tracking
text: Plans meals, manages grocery lists and tracks symptoms to investigate food-related digestive issues, driven by a repository of specification and memory files.

title: TypeScript codebase ported to Rust
text: Ports a 100,000-line TypeScript codebase to Rust over about a month, running the translation in a terminal coding tool.

title: Subway status page for San Francisco
text: Downloads real-time circuit-diagram images of the San Francisco subway, builds a labeling tool, and creates a machine-learning status page that says whether to take the subway or a bus.

title: Three-month Typefully clone
text: Clones a Twitter scheduling tool over three months, adding an influencer finder that analyzes lists to discover creators and downloads their tweets.

title: Promo videos for software projects
text: Creates short promo videos for software projects by installing Remotion, reading the project's styling for branding, and following a hook, problem and solution structure.

title: C++ and Haskell codebases translated
text: Rewrites a non-trivial C++ codebase in Java and a Haskell codebase in Clojure by asking for a full reimplementation of each.

title: Local meeting transcription CLI
text: Builds a fully local macOS transcription command-line tool that records microphone and system audio on separate channels and writes real-time markdown notes in ten-second chunks.

title: Historical figures debate the news
text: Runs an automated news-debate site where bots styled after historical figures and political perspectives post threaded replies to news ingested every fifteen minutes.

title: Drafting a book with an assistant
text: Drafts the first version of a technical book with an assistant, then copy-edits roughly 20 to 30 hours per chapter and finishes in about two months.

title: Fake secrets in env files
text: Replaces real credentials in .env files on disk with structurally valid fakes while the editor shows the real values, so coding tools reading the file never see live keys.

title: Reimplementing a researcher's papers
text: Reimplements 58 problems from one researcher's papers as runnable code, each with a training animation and a short note on what the visualization shows.

title: Voice interview during a dog walk
text: Interviews a person by voice through a phone app during a dog walk, then tidies the transcribed conversation into a blog post.

title: GraphiQL rewritten in Svelte
text: Rewrites the React-based GraphiQL interface in Svelte, publishes it to npm, and upgrades a GraphQL server to use it.

title: Notational Velocity reboot in Swift
text: Reboots the Notational Velocity note app as a Swift Mac app that stores notes as markdown files compatible with Obsidian.

title: Containerized sessions from issue trackers
text: Runs containerized coding sessions from Jira, GitLab and Forgejo issues, with one branch per issue, automatic pull requests, CI response and incorporation of review feedback.

title: Ten-minute films from a playbook
text: Produces 10-minute films by directing video, image and voice generators from a markdown playbook, taking about two and a half hours for a first pass.

title: Zig to Rust migration
text: Migrates a production runtime codebase from Zig to Rust, producing about a million lines in under two weeks while keeping the existing test suite passing.

title: Building a shooter with the kids
text: Builds a first-person shooter together with two children acting as product managers, reaching a playable game in the first three hours.

title: Selenium test automation framework
text: Builds a Spring Boot inspired Java framework for Selenium test automation with semantic locators, thread-safe parallel runs, an IntelliJ plugin and a tool server.

title: Prompt library from past sessions
text: Turns past coding-session history into a reusable prompt library so recurring preferences and answers do not have to be restated at the start of every session.

title: Decompiled SimTower in the browser
text: Rewrites a classic tower-building game for the browser from a Ghidra decompilation, loading the user's original binary on the page to extract its assets, over six months.

title: F-Zero X ported to 3DS
text: Ports a console racing game to the Nintendo 3DS, reaching stereoscopic rendering at 60 frames per second.

title: Single-file installer builder
text: Builds a single offline HTML page that generates cross-platform installers for Windows, Linux and Mac projects.

title: Research notes workspace
text: Builds a research workspace in one month where a topic description creates a project, searches arXiv and imports papers, with a PDF reader showing translations side by side.

title: Billable hours from session logs
text: Reconstructs billable hours for client work from the local session logs of two different coding tools.

title: Interactive signal processing pages
text: Assembles interactive pages for exploring basic digital signal processing topics over a weekend, favoring animations over static textbook diagrams and heavy math.

title: Chess mistake spaced repetition
text: Builds spaced-repetition chess training from a player's own computer-analyzed Lichess games, extending the site's mistake review with a sample deck and a ported interface.

title: Books mentioned on Hacker News
text: Collects about 16,500 books mentioned by at least two commenters since 2007 into a site where each book links back to the comments that mentioned it.

title: Beatmatching trainer from one-shot prompts
text: Builds a beatmatching practice tool with Winamp-skinned decks using one prompt per feature or bug fix, with no human code review.

title: Datalog interpreter in awk
text: Builds a semi-naive Datalog interpreter in pure POSIX awk that can be copied into a project and used during build or test stages without dependencies.

title: Finding browser and OS exploit chains
text: Finds multi-step attack chains leading to remote code execution in widely used browsers and operating systems, across both open-source and proprietary software.
